description: Permanently deletes a thought along with its note and links. There is no undo. Requires human confirmation. Do not call it to tidy up on your own initiative — only when the user explicitly asked for a deletion.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

confirm.description: Set to true only after a human has confirmed the deletion. Do not decide this on their behalf.

name: brain_delete_thought
